entry.title: FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency
entry.summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction. entry.title: Learning Grounded Reasoning from Human Gaze
entry.summary: Human visual reasoning is driven by systematic exploration and extraction of task-relevant visual evidence. Human gaze provides a window into this process, making gaze a useful source of guidance for visually-grounded reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs). entry.title: Nunchi: Ears Help Eyes in Multi-Party Conversations
entry.summary: Identifying whom a person looks at is central to understanding multi-party conversations, yet gaze geometry alone becomes ambiguous as more people appear. Conversations offer cues that geometry lacks, such as who is speaking and what is said, but no gaze dataset provides them for many multi-party scenes. entry.title: MillBill: A Machining Agent with Geometric Feedback
entry.summary: Turning a CAD model into a machining program requires both process knowledge and geometric precision. entry.title: CADMAGEDDON: High-Fidelity CAD Reconstruction with Local Inference
entry.summary: CAD practitioners often work with proprietary parts that they are unwilling to share with external services.
